# Kenney interface-polish selection

This folder contains a deliberately small selection from two Kenney asset packs:

- UI Pack — <https://kenney.nl/assets/ui-pack>
- Interface Sounds — <https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds>

Both packs are available under Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal (CC0). The Interface Sounds package's original licence text is retained as `InterfaceSounds_LICENSE.txt` beside the imported files. Source and local-use details are recorded in `Docs/THIRD_PARTY_ASSETS.md`.

The files were acquired on 2026-09-05. Their pixels/audio are unchanged; only the project selection and Unity import metadata are project-local.
